description: FastAPI route handlers for user login, password recovery, token testing, and password reset, including email notifications and security integrations.

methods.name: login_access_token
methods.description: Handles OAuth2 login, returns access token if credentials are valid.

methods.name: test_token
methods.description: Returns current user info to verify token validity.

methods.name: recover_password
methods.description: Initiates password recovery process, sends email if user exists.

methods.name: reset_password
methods.description: Resets user password after verifying reset token.

methods.name: recover_password_html_content
methods.description: Provides HTML content for password recovery email, restricted to superusers.
